I've added a list of currently readings as well. If you want a full list of books I've finished lately, or how I've rated them, check out my Goodreads page.

## The Record Store

What I'm currently listening to, along with my favorites so far this year.

### Now Playing:

Finally getting around to the newest release from Car Seat Headrest, and I love it. It's a sprawling work, with playtimes pushing well past 10 minutes on multiple tracks. Admittedly not for everyone, but as a Mars Volta fan, I appreciate when a band leans into it.

[![This album from Car Seat Headrest is a masterpiece.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/f/f2/Car_Seat_Headrest_-_The_Scholars_album_artwork.png){width="250" fig-align="left"}](https://open.spotify.com/album/3EuXbeOZZukUbq4ZdreJzV?si=Clis-WvzQvSGQavm3Hv2pA)
